result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.delete_edge_by_id()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Delete an edge from the graph by its ID. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L867-L932){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.delete_edge_by_id(edge_id) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Removes an edge directly using its unique edge identifier. This is more efficient than deleting by source and target nodes when the edge ID is known, and is particularly useful for multigraphs where multiple edges may exist between the same pair of nodes. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [edge_id]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The unique identifier of the edge to remove. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Returns self to enable method chaining. ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [KeyError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If no edge exists with the specified ID. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Delete an edge by its ID: ::: {#233d4e55 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_edge(source="A", target="B") ) # Get and delete the edge edge_id = graph.get_edge_ids()[0] graph.delete_edge_by_id(edge_id=edge_id) # Edge no longer exists graph.has_edge(source="A", target="B") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` False ``` ::: ::: Delete specific edges in a multigraph: ::: {#5fb7574b .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_edge(source="A", target="B", weight=1.0) .add_edge(source="A", target="B", weight=2.0) ) # Delete only the first edge edge_ids = graph.get_edge_ids() graph.delete_edge_by_id(edge_id=edge_ids[0]) # Second edge still remains graph.has_edge(source="A", target="B") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` True ``` ::: :::
